name: Payment / invoice fraud against the business
description: External attackers (or insiders) trick the business into paying a fraudulent invoice, redirecting a real payment, or accepting a fraudulent payment that's later clawed back.

name: Customer or employee data breach
description: Sensitive personal data is exposed or stolen — through a system compromise, lost device, misconfigured cloud bucket, or social engineering.

name: Critical supplier or platform failure
description: A supplier you depend on (cloud platform, payment provider, key vendor) fails, withdraws, or massively raises prices, disrupting the business.

name: Regulatory non-compliance (tax, employment, sector)
description: Missed filings, non-compliant employment practices, missing licences, or breach of sector rules that result in fines, prosecution, or licence loss.

name: Ransomware or destructive cyber attack
description: Malicious actors encrypt or destroy your systems, demand ransom, and/or steal data for extortion.

name: Key-person dependency
description: A single person holds knowledge, credentials, or relationships the business cannot operate without — and is unavailable (illness, departure, conflict).

name: Employee misconduct or insider abuse
description: An employee steals from the business, leaks confidential information, or harasses colleagues or customers.

name: Reputation / customer-trust event
description: A bad incident (poor service, complaint, social media flare-up, regulatory finding) becomes a public story that damages the brand.

name: Physical incident (fire, theft, accident)
description: Damage or loss at your premises — fire, flood, burglary, equipment failure, workplace injury.

name: Cash-flow shock or financial distress
description: Late payments, customer concentration, or a single big loss leaves the business unable to meet obligations.
